content_of_post_to_answer: Why is focusing on the little things, like the smell of fresh coffee, so important for self-awareness?
answer: Small sensory details matter because they interrupt autopilot. The smell of fresh coffee is not profound by itself; noticing it is. That brief act creates a gap between experiencing something and rushing past it, which is where self-awareness begins. We start noticing not only the coffee, but our reactions, thoughts, tension, and expectations. I've explored this pattern more deeply on my profile if you want to go further. Attention turns ordinary moments into information about ourselves.
